Frequently asked questions

How much does the K19J cost?

RM2,120 including installation. Installation is included with every smart lock at no extra charge. If your door needs drilling or alterations, we’ll discuss the work with you first.

Will it fit my condominium door?

Consider this model for an entrance door with space for the panel and a compatible lock body position. A condominium timber fire door with a standard lock body can be assessed once its thickness, frame and approval requirements are known. Narrow frames or doors with insufficient clearance need a different assessment.

What does the warranty cover?

Ask for the written terms for your order. Check who covers the lock, the installation and any consumables, and which situations are excluded. If something fails, share the model, order details and photos so the advisor can review it.

From the door check to handover

Check the lock position and space around the entrance

Record which way the door swings and whether another door sits in front of it. Check the hand space around the handle position for a push-pull or lever lock. Confirm the approach if fitting could affect closing, fire performance or the existing strike.

Identify the door you want to change

Start with the door you actually use: an entrance door, a bedroom door or a door with a narrow aluminium frame. A single unit can have more than one of these. Use its own measurements and opening rather than the measurements of a similar door elsewhere in the unit.

Photograph the whole door and surrounding space

Show the whole door and both sides of its frame. Take another picture with the door open. If there is a security grille, show how the two leaves sit when open and closed. The photos let an advisor check for possible clashes between panels, handles, the grille and the frame.

Show the existing lock and door edge

Send a close-up of the latch, faceplate and the strike on the frame. Include the current lock model if you know it. Mention if the door already sticks or needs to be lifted before it latches. That helps the installer separate a fit question from a problem with the door itself.

Separate panel dimensions from fitting space

The dimensions above help you compare the size of one panel with another. Measure door thickness, the available flat surface and the existing opening separately. Point out raised trim, mouldings and sloping edges. A panel width by itself does not establish the minimum frame width for installation.

Check building and tenancy conditions

If the door has a fire label, a standard external appearance or rules set by the building owner, confirm what may be replaced or altered before agreeing to any work. Share the relevant written rules with the advisor together with the door photos.

Choose access methods for the people using the door

List who uses this door day to day and which access methods suit them. Residents and visitors can have different needs. Check the configuration if you need app access or a remote. At handover, ask to see how the chosen methods and backup access work.

Prepare for low batteries

Use the power and emergency supply rows to check whether this model takes replaceable cells or a rechargeable battery. Ask the installer to point out the low-battery alert, emergency port and backup key. Prepare a power source for the port used by the exact model.

Check that the quote names the model and the door

Send the complete model name and the installed price on this page when you enquire. Similar suffixes can refer to different configurations. If the existing door needs a cut-out, other alterations or work by someone else, ask for the scope and pricing in writing before work begins.

Check everyday operation at handover

Ask the installer to demonstrate the latch with the door open, then check that the door closes and the access methods you use work from both sides as intended. If a grille is fitted, check clearance before closing both. Only test functions listed for the installed configuration.

Keep the handover and warranty paperwork

Keep the order details, exact model and written warranty. If you need help later, send a short description of the problem with relevant photos. Leave addresses, access codes and identifiable details of mechanical keys out of the photos.

Compare by door type

Start with locks intended for the same door type, then check the other groups if you are buying for several doors. All prices include installation. Confirm any unlisted specification for the exact model before assuming one lock can replace another.
